verdict.rationale: Lever documents built-in analytics dashboards ("build, templatize, and share polished dashboards", forecast/trend tracking) and a general developer API/OAuth/webhooks platform that could be used to extract data, but there is no explicit mention of scheduled exports, a documented reporting/analytics API, or named BI-tool connectors (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Snowflake) for warehouse sync. missing for 10: explicit scheduled export feature, named BI connector integrations, a documented analytics/reporting API endpoint distinct from the general applications API.
